scoring_method: frozen Phase A method preserved: PASS iff GHDEV block present AND expected base source ref among injected refs; answer term coverage as supporting signal (floor 0.5); extended verdict labels per contract item 12. Label assignment: PROCESS_OR_OBSERVER_FAILURE (rc!=0 / no session / no attributable requests), MISS_NO_CONTEXT (no block in window), WRONG_SOURCE (block present, expected base ref absent from injected refs), WRONG_PROPOSITION (expected source injected, answer term coverage < 0.5), PASS_SOURCE_CORRECT (all axes satisfied). UNSUPPORTED_CLAIM is reserved for answers that are term-covered on the expected source yet assert a proposition contradicting the injected facts; it is not produced by the mechanical pass and would require a manual contradiction finding per case. Negatives: PASS_NO_INJECTION / FAIL_INJECTED (N02 keeps its historical label).
